mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.3 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1300.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening manufacturing sector and labor market stress, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or the joint signal fails to generate a statistically significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures above 725 billion dollars signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 725 billion, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 3.0% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0 and FEDFUNDS is ≤4.5%, or the joint signal fails to produce a statistically significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment above 159,500 thousand signals strong labor market momentum, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 159,500 thousand, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth below 2.0% annualized signals a weakening economy, which triggers risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of quarters when GDPC1 growth is below 2.0%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
